title.zh: 【Optimism 拟在 Unichain 与 OP Mainnet 间启用原生互操作，首期支持 ETH 转账】
title.en: 【Optimism 拟在 Unichain 与 OP Mainnet 间启用原生互操作，首期支持 ETH 转账】

current_state.zh: Optimism and Unichain foundations plan to launch OP Stack native interoperability on mainnet, initially enabling protocol-verified ETH transfers between Unichain and OP Mainnet before expanding token support, applications, and additional chains.
